description: Change one section: merge-patch its settings (null removes a key; settings: null resets them all) and/or hide/show it. Ids come from get_site.document.templates[page_id]. An outside image url in an image setting is copied into the business's media library and the setting stores our copy; if it can't be downloaded the call fails with image_fetch_failed and nothing changes.

page_id.description: Page id, e.g. home, menu, about, loyalty

anyOf.description: Settings as a JSON merge patch (null removes a key). get_site lists each type's settings.

settings.description: Settings as a JSON merge patch (null removes a key). get_site lists each type's settings.

name: update_section
title: Update section
